episodes.title: Telarañas
episodes.summary: The quiet town of Pedraza is shaken by the birth of a mysterious child. Local vet Elena and Mayor Paco investigate the incident and begin to uncover the troubling past of their newly appointed priest, Father Vergara – and the significance of a curious coin he has in his possession.

episodes.title: Ouija
episodes.summary: When a local teenager suddenly disappears, Elena explores Father Vergara's possible connection. As more untimely deaths befall the town, Marquess Roque presents Elena with an enticing job offer, and Merche urges Paco to keep his distance.

episodes.title: El espejo
episodes.summary: Elena and Paco discover that a local mirror is haunted. When Father Vergara spends the night investigating the mirror's trickery, he risks getting swept into its deathly portal.

episodes.title: Recuerdos
episodes.summary: Father Vergara leaves for Rome to face his painful past. He requests a meeting with the Pope, but he discovers that Santoro is waiting for him too. Meanwhile in Pedraza, someone is about to return from the dead.

episodes.title: El doble
episodes.summary: After mysteriously disappearing two years ago, Elena's husband miraculously returns. In Rome, Santoro tries to recruit Vergara, offering him unimaginable power…

episodes.title: Guerra Santa
episodes.summary: While Father Vergara seeks refuge from Santoro in Aleppo, he ventures into the dream world to contact Elena, who's eloped to Paris with Roque. Meanwhile, in Pedraza, marital tensions between Paco and Merche reach a boiling point, and federal agents descend on the town to take matters into their own hands.

episodes.title: La caja de cristal
episodes.summary: When the sinister new priest prepares a great ritual, a magical fog descends over the village. Vergara and Elena, return with the coin while Paco attempts to resist the conspiracy. The epic confrontation of good vs. evil has finally arrived.

episodes.title: Sacrificio
episodes.summary: Vergara, Paco and Elena confront biblical demons while the Cainites seize the village. If they get hold of the 30 coins, an unprecedented power shall emerge, and with it, a Pope for the new world order under Satan's rule.

episodes.title: El pueblo fantasma
episodes.summary: As former inhabitants consider Pedraza's mysteries, Paco tends to a hospitalized Elena, and Father Vergara adjusts to his new reality.

episodes.title: Las tierras del sueño
episodes.summary: While an empowered Merche revels in her newfound abilities, Paco fights to save Elena from a horrifying ritual.

episodes.title: Criaturas infernales
episodes.summary: Elena and Paco adjust to their unexpected new circumstances, as Antonio's visions reveal Barbrow's sinister intentions.

episodes.title: El libro negro del árabe loco
episodes.summary: As Elena confronts the horrific truth behind her pregnancy, Laguna goes undercover, and Barbrow presents Merche with a tempting offer.

episodes.title: El símbolo arcano
episodes.summary: At the psychiatric hospital, Laguna discovers a new clue about Barbrow's plans that will lead Salcedo to England. The millionaire will have to test his magical powers to snatch the black book found in Toledo from Elena and Paco. Only the help of Antonio and Haruka will allow them to begin their journey to Rome and reach Father Lombardi.

episodes.title: Resetear el mundo
episodes.summary: While Barbrow unveils his sinister plan at Highclaire Forum, Paco and Elena work with Father Lombardi to uncover a dark truth.

episodes.title: Los dos núcleos
episodes.summary: Hoping to halt Barbrow's plans, Antonio leads a charge to destroy the Second Nucleus; when Paco wakes up in a mysterious location, Elena must work with Vergara and Santoro to secure a key weapon.

episodes.title: El ojo de Dios
episodes.summary: While Haruka and Antonio race to defeat the supercomputer, Vergara and Elena fight to save Paco and bring down Barbrow.
